title: Closure: close on silence, reopen on recurrence, escalate after two failed fixes

story.i_want_to: have a finding's issue closed only when its signal has stayed quiet, and reopened when it comes back
story.so_that: a fix is judged by the ledger, not by a merged PR, and a fix that did not hold is retried or brought to me

rationale: chg#22 S14 steps 5-6 and the 'two failed fixes, then a person' guard.

acceptance_criteria.description: When the story the delivery loop made from a finding's issue reaches merged, the finding moves to fixed and records the merge sha and time.

The sweep closes the issue of a fixed finding not seen for a configured quiet period after the fix merged (default 7 days, one module attribute) with a comment naming the period and the last sighting, and moves it to closed.

A sighting of a fixed or closed finding's fingerprint after its fix merged increments fix_attempts, reopens the issue (or files it again if it cannot be reopened) with a 'fix did not hold' comment carrying the new occurrences, and moves it back to filed.

At fix_attempts 2 the finding moves to escalated instead of reopening, and the issue gets a comment and the label chg-loop-escalated; the sweep files nothing more for that fingerprint until a user-role key clears it.

test_cases.name: quiet period closes
preconditions: a fixed finding last seen before its merge
